prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: final macOS app icon for Mixless, a dual-deck DJ and automatic audio mixing app. Create one original, immediately recognizable compact DJ mixing console icon. Front-on orthographic view, a bold almost-square mixer faceplate centered in the frame, filling about 72 percent of the canvas. Three large round rotary knobs along the top; two clearly separated vertical channel-fader slots with chunky slider caps at different heights in the middle; one horizontal crossfader at the bottom to communicate blending two music tracks. Simplify the hardware into a memorable, beautifully balanced silhouette with generous negative space and clean, thick shapes that still read at 32 pixels. Warm amber-gold faceplate transitioning subtly toward coral-orange on the right edge, deep graphite inset slots and knobs, small cream highlights. The surrounding canvas is a completely uniform opaque near-black graphite #141416, extending all the way to all four square corners. Polished restrained macOS visual style, slightly tactile with very subtle bevels, crisp geometry, strong contrast, minimal detail. The mixer itself has softly rounded corners. The outer image is a full square with no rounded app tile or enclosing border. Only the mixer as the central symbol. No lettering, no letter M, no words, no numbers, no labels, no tiny tick marks, no headphones, no musical notes, no turntables, no sparkles, no background scenery, no watermark, no multiple proposals, no presentation mockup.
